name: modules-tools-result-unknown-sidecar-binding
about: 同 modules-tools-result-unknown 的输入，循环经 modules.agentLoop 的 module-stdio-v2 绑定跑在外部 sidecar 里（绑定写法见 modules-tools-batch-sidecar-binding）：外部模块回 ok:false + outcome:result_unknown 时，基线外部 sidecar 的工具端口按外部循环处理。sidecar 起的连接 / 实例 id 与 streamId 随机，按 modules-tools-sidecar-stdio 同样声明。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  agentLoop:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: pilotdeck-agent-loop
    contract: pilotdeck.agent-loop/v1
    transport: module-stdio-v2
    command: /bin/sh
    args:
      - -c
      - 'eval "exec $BBX_SIDECAR"'
  skills:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
  modelProvider:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
  context:
    enabled: true
    provider: pilotdeck
  knowledge:
    enabled: false
  tools:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: bbx.tools
    contract: pilotdeck.tools/v1
    transport: module-http-v2
    endpoint: {MOCK}/tools
    timeoutMs: 1500
    methods:
      - execute
    catalog:
      - name: bbx_echo
        description: Echo text through the external capability module.
        inputSchema:
          type: object
          properties:
            text:
              type: string
          required:
            - text
